## What's new

**Personal Guards use far fewer Discord requests**
- Personal Guards no longer re-read your guards' DMs every minute in the background.
- When Discord starts, only your 5 most recent DMs are checked (was 20), one page each.
- Opening a DM, a reaction, joining voice or right-clicking someone reads just the latest 100 messages of that DM.
- Sending a guard action or accepting/refusing an invite reads at most 1000 messages instead of the whole DM history.
- Guard actions still run automatically on the owner's Discord, so a guard can still mute someone who fell asleep.

If you accepted an invitation on another device, it now shows up when you open that DM (instead of within a minute). If an invitation is more than 1000 messages back in the DM, ask the owner to send a new one.

## Update

Use the update notification in Discord. If it fails, download `FriendsInVoice-v1.18.6.zip`, extract the whole archive and run `repair.bat` (macOS: `repair.command`, Linux: `bash repair.sh`).

BetterDiscord: replace the installed plugin with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release and enable it.

## Verification

Personal Guards tests (33, including a new page-limit test) and 29 BetterDiscord tests pass; the platform workflow builds Vencord on macOS and Linux.
